meaning_hint: Used for the figurative/psychological sense and in electronics/programming; a gun trigger = спусковий гачок.

examples: What are your symptoms?
A fever is a common symptom of flu.
Call the doctor if the symptoms get worse.
I have no symptoms today.

meaning_hint: Most often a person who looks after a park or forest (a park ranger).
examples: The rangers were trained for special missions.
He served as an Army Ranger for six years.
The rangers attacked at night.
Only the best soldiers become rangers.
note: Also a park ranger who protects a forest or park.

examples: Parliament will vote on the new law.
He was elected to parliament last year.
The parliament building is in the capital.
Parliament meets again next week.
Would you like some tomato sauce?
The pasta sauce is homemade.
Dip the chicken in the sauce.
This sauce is too spicy for me.
The narrator tells the story in the first person.
The audiobook has a great narrator.
We never learn the narrator's name.
The documentary's narrator has a calm voice.
We saw a celebrity at the airport.
She wants to be a celebrity.
Many celebrities live in this area.
I took a photo with a celebrity!

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian also a site or facility (будівельний об'єкт).
examples: There is a strange object on the table.
The museum has objects from ancient Egypt.
Do not put metal objects in the microwave.
The baby likes to grab shiny objects.
My sister is a fashion designer.
We need a designer for our website.
The designer made a new logo for us.
He works as a game designer.
Let's take a taxi to the airport.
I called a taxi at midnight.
The taxi driver knew a shortcut.
Taxis are expensive in this city.
note: In the US, "cab" is also very common.

examples: The old fort is on the hill.
Soldiers lived in the fort.
We visited a fort from the 1800s.
The fort protected the city.
The vampire only comes out at night.
My kids love vampire movies.
In stories, vampires drink blood.
He dressed as a vampire for Halloween.

meaning_hint: Ukrainian пас = a pass of the ball, or 'pass' in card games; not a ticket/permit or mountain pass.
examples: He made a long pass to his teammate.
That was a perfect pass.
She scored after a great pass.
The pass was too short.
I found a penny on the sidewalk.
This candy costs only a few pennies.
He saved every penny for a new bike.
The jar is full of old pennies.
The jinn came out of the lamp.
In the story, a jinn grants three wishes.
My kids love stories about jinn.
The old book tells tales of jinn.
note: In fairy tales people usually say "genie". Jinn is often also the plural.

meaning_hint: Only a reason that supports a point; a quarrel = сварка
examples: That's a good argument.
What is your main argument?
His argument made sense to me.
I don't agree with your argument.
note: Also often means a fight with words: "We had an argument."

meaning_hint: Also figurative (political climate).
examples: The climate here is warm and dry.
I don't like a cold climate.
Climate change is a big problem.
The climate in Florida is good for oranges.

meaning_hint: British spelling; American English writes check. Ukrainian чек also means a shop receipt.
examples: Can we have the check, please?
He paid the check after dinner.
The waiter brought the check to our table.
Let me split the check with you.
note: In a US restaurant, the bill is called "the check."

meaning_hint: Indeclinable in Ukrainian.
examples: The shop is on Fifth Avenue.
Turn left onto the avenue.
We live on a busy avenue.
Walk two blocks down the avenue.
note: In addresses it is often short: Ave.

meaning_hint: Obsolete in Ukrainian; the normal word is слон.
examples: The elephant drank water from the river.
We saw elephants at the zoo.
Elephants have very good memory.
The baby elephant followed its mother.
I love your outfit today!
She bought a new outfit for the party.
He wore a black outfit to the concert.
What outfit should I wear tonight?

meaning_hint: indeclinable; also татуювання
examples: He has a tattoo of a dragon on his arm.
She got her first tattoo at eighteen.
My mom doesn't like tattoos.
The tattoo took three hours to finish.
I live on campus this year.
The library is in the middle of campus.
Can you show me around the campus?
There is a nice cafe on campus.

meaning_hint: In sports the usual word is суперник
examples: Our opponent is a strong team.
She shook hands with her opponent.
He beat his opponent in two games.
Who is your next opponent?

meaning_hint: Also an official certificate/report document.
examples: Congress passed a new act on clean water.
The act protects workers' rights.
This act became law last year.
The new act changes the tax rules.
She works in marketing.
Good marketing helps a small business grow.
Our marketing team is very small.
I want to study marketing at college.
The two countries formed an alliance.
The alliance helped protect its members.
They signed an alliance after the war.
The alliance has thirty member countries.

meaning_hint: Often as an exclamation: Супер! = Great!
examples: That's a super idea!
The party was super fun.
Thanks, you're super nice.
I'm super tired today.
note: Informal. Often used before adjectives to mean "very": super easy.

examples: I got a bonus at work this year.
Workers get a bonus in December.
The free coffee is a nice bonus.
Did you get your bonus yet?
The timing of the meeting was perfect.
Good timing is key in comedy.
Her timing was bad; the store had just closed.
We need to check the timing of the project.

meaning_hint: вертоліт is also common
examples: A helicopter landed on the roof.
They flew over the city in a helicopter.
The rescue helicopter arrived quickly.
We heard a helicopter above the house.
The city is full of tourists in the summer.
Tourists took photos of the old church.
The museum is popular with tourists.
We felt like tourists in our own town.
I read her travel blog every week.
He writes a blog about cooking.
I started a blog last year.
Did you see the new post on my blog?

meaning_hint: Also a political bloc; a city block is квартал.
examples: The store is two blocks away.
We walked around the block.
He lives on my block.
The kids built a tower of blocks.

meaning_hint: A sudden boom (economic, popularity); also the sound бум!
examples: There was a housing boom in the city.
The tech boom created many jobs.
Sales had a boom last summer.
The town grew fast during the oil boom.

meaning_hint: Only the noun; to volunteer = зголоситися, волонтерити.
examples: She works as a volunteer at the hospital.
We need more volunteers for the event.
Volunteers cleaned the park.
He is a volunteer firefighter.

meaning_hint: Physical comfort or ease; comfort as consolation is втіха, розрада.
examples: This hotel offers comfort at a good price.
I like the comfort of my own bed.
They live in comfort in a big house.
The car is built for comfort on long trips.

meaning_hint: Only a sports court (tennis etc.); a law court is суд.
examples: We played tennis on the court near my house.
The players walked onto the court.
The basketball court is open until ten.
She practices on an indoor court in winter.
She got a grant to study abroad.
The school received a grant for new computers.
He applied for a research grant.
The grant covers all her travel costs.
There was a big protest in the city.
Many students went to the protest.
The protest was peaceful.
The road is closed because of a protest.
I buy most of my clothes online.
You can pay your bills online.
We met online two years ago.
Is the store open online on Sundays?
She is a famous poet from Chicago.
The poet read his poems on stage.
My favorite poet writes about nature.
He wanted to be a poet as a child.
My dad loves listening to jazz.
They play live jazz on Fridays.
She sings jazz in a small club.
New Orleans is famous for jazz.
She works at the travel bureau downtown.
The weather bureau warned of a storm.
Call the bureau for more information.
The bureau opens at nine in the morning.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian a geography term (steep sea cliff); the everyday word is скеля or урвище.
examples: The house stands on top of a high cliff.
Do not walk too close to the cliff edge.
Birds build nests on the rocky cliffs.
We watched the sunset from the cliffs by the sea.
Her son is a teenager now.
Many teenagers spend hours on their phones.
The club is for teenagers only.
I moved to the city as a teenager.
She got a certificate for finishing the course.
You need a certificate to teach English.
The certificate is hanging on the wall.
He received a certificate of completion.

meaning_hint: The unit of length (British spelling: metre); a measuring device (gas/water meter) is лічильник.
examples: The room is five meters long.
She ran the one hundred meters in twelve seconds.
The tree is about ten meters tall.
We need two meters of cloth.
The kids are going to summer camp in July.
We set up camp near the lake.
The camp has tents, a kitchen, and showers.
My son loved his first week at camp.

meaning_hint: a British noble title; in Ukrainian it is usually translated as граф
examples: The earl lived in a huge castle.
His father was an earl in England.
The earl owned most of the land around the village.
She married the son of an earl.
Let's meet at the pub after work.
The pub was full of football fans.
We had dinner at an old English pub.
He went to the pub with friends.

meaning_hint: In Ukraine паспорт is also the internal ID document.
examples: Don't forget your passport at the airport.
My passport expires next month.
She showed her passport at the border.
I need to renew my passport soon.

meaning_hint: атлет also = a strong, muscular man; a sportsperson is also спортсмен.
examples: She is a great athlete.
The athletes train every morning.
He wants to be a professional athlete.
Many athletes eat a lot of protein.
The city was in chaos after the storm.
There was total chaos at the airport.
The kids caused chaos in the kitchen.
The new rules led to chaos.

meaning_hint: Noun only; 'to transport' = перевозити
examples: Public transport is cheap here.
I use public transport every day.
What transport do you take to work?
Transport in this city is very good.
note: In American English "transportation" is more common: public transportation.

meaning_hint: Only a 'like' on social media; the verb 'to like' is подобатися.
examples: Her photo got hundreds of likes.
Thanks for all the likes and comments!
The video has more likes than views.
He checks his likes every hour.

meaning_hint: рейд also = a roadstead (sheltered anchorage for ships)
examples: The army carried out a raid on the enemy camp.
Police made a raid on the building at dawn.
The air raid lasted all night.
Soldiers were killed in the raid.

meaning_hint: Also a computer menu.
examples: Can I see the menu, please?
The menu has many vegetarian dishes.
What's on the menu today?
The kids' menu is on the back.
